method: Same-host alternating installed interpreters via the released compare_release_benchmarks.summarize and compare functions. The existing 0.3.0 environment was used. Its PEP 610 wheel hash, all hashed RECORD entries, original benchmark engine SHA, source and ruleset identities and named workloads were verified. 0.4.0 was installed fresh from the sealed wheel. Neither interpreter imports the checkout. Each suite runs in a fresh isolated-mode process.
